profile.description: Discriminator. guard.input records the verdict for one screened inbound content item.

ruleset_id.description: Identifier of the prompt-injection ruleset applied.

ruleset_hash.description: sha256 commit pinning the exact ruleset contents.

content_commit.description: sha256 commit of the screened content.

decision.description: Guard verdict: pass = clean, flagged = suspicious but allowed through, blocked = rejected.

matched_rules.description: Ordered list of rule identifiers that matched (empty when decision is pass).

detector.description: Identity of the detector component that produced the verdict.

model.description: Model identifier when kind involves an LLM judge.

content_media_type.description: MIME type of the screened content (e.g. text/plain, application/json).

credential_id.description: Capability credential id the screened request was produced under.

profiles.regulation: Dekimu Guard — per-input prompt-injection screening verdict
